chapter.heading: Psalm 6
O LORD, Deliver My Life
To the choirmaster: with stringed instruments; according to The Sheminith.(1) A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
O LORD,
rebuke me,
not in your anger, nor discipline me in your wrath.

Be gracious
to me,,
O LORD, for I am languishing; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are troubled.

My soul
also is,
greatly troubled. But you, O LORD—how long?

Turn, O
LORD, deliver,
my life; save me for the sake of your steadfast love.

For in
death there,
is no remembrance of you; in Sheol who will give you praise?

I am
weary with,
my moaning; every night I flood my bed with tears; I drench my couch with my weeping.

My eye
wastes away,
because of grief; it grows weak because of all my foes.

Depart from
me, all,
you workers of evil, for the LORD has heard the sound of my weeping.

The LORD
has heard,
my plea; the LORD accepts my prayer.

All my
enemies shall,
be ashamed and greatly troubled; they shall turn back and be put to shame in a moment. Footnotes (1) 6:1 Probably a musical or liturgical term (ESV)
